title: 第一卷 第48章 面见裴惊寒第一卷 第47章 七品巅峰
lines: “哟，你小子胃口还不小呢！这才刚突破到七品巅峰，就想着再到六品了呀！”
“做人嘛，总是要有点梦想的！”
“说的有道理，那我就来跟你讲讲吧。”
李铁柱靠墙坐下。
“七品到九品练的是身体，皮肉筋骨气血，说白了，就是不断压榨自己身体的潜能。”
“到了七品巅峰，也就算是把身体练到极限了，再往上，就不能光练身体了”
“从六品开始，武夫体内就能炼出真气。”
“真气运用得当，可以附着在武器上，隔着好几步也能击伤妖物。”
“还可以在身体外围形成一层防护，跟之前拿身体硬扛就不是一回事儿了。”
秦烈听得很认真，原本以为大家都是练体的，没想到七品之上就开始炼气了。
“那一品是什么样子的？”
李铁柱看了他一眼。
“刚才我说你胃口不小时看清你了，你是胃口大的可怕呀！”
“才七品巅峰，又开始惦记一品了。”
“我就想知道咱们将军是不是就是一品高手？”
李铁柱顺着他的目光看向城楼，裴惊寒依旧站在那里。
这两天，只要有底下士卒应付不了的大妖冲阵，他必然会出手。
李铁柱的声音压低了几分，那是一种连他这种六品巅峰的高手提起来都带着几分敬畏的语气。
“九品到七品叫炼体三境，六品到四品叫炼气三境，三品到一品叫宗师三境。”
“我这种人混到六品巅峰，已经算是有点本事了，可在裴将军面前，连提鞋的资格都不够。”
“至于一品……”
“那不是咱们这种人该想的，裴将军这种人往城楼上一站，就能保证整个断风营军心不散，这就是一品！”
秦烈看着裴惊寒的背影，没有再追问下去。
让李铁柱这个六品巅峰跟他形容一品的厉害，确实有点强人所难了。
要是有机会能够见到裴惊寒亲自问一问就好了，不过现在的秦烈显然不够格。
接下来的时间里，秦烈的境界再也没有任何提升。
不是他不想，是基础炼体已经到了极限，再往上走必须要有练气功法才行。
没有功法，光有属性点也是白搭呀。
家业值系统里倒是可以兑换，但是自己的家业值不够。
看来这趟回去了之后，一定要把柳芸娘他们接过来了。
不过，好在三维还没有加满，自由属性点还有用处。
第三天，他把体质拉到了七品巅峰能够承受到的极限。
那一天，妖族冲了五次城墙，秦烈从早上一直杀到了天黑。
体质提上去之后，他觉得自己的体力变得更加持久。
换成之前最多连续打上一个时辰，手就开始抖了。
现在只要给他一点喘息的功夫，他就能重新站起来再战。
第四天，他把敏捷拉到了极限。
妖物扑上来的时候，他能很清晰地看到妖物的动作。
低等妖兽刚翻上城墙，他的刀就已经斩了过去。
那些小妖境中期和后期的妖物想要后突袭他，也能很快地临时变换身形。
content_en:
"Hey, you kid has a big appetite! You have just reached the peak of the seventh level, and you are already thinking about going to the sixth level!"
"As a human being, you always have to have some dreams!"
"That makes sense, so let me tell you about it."
Li Tiezhu sat down against the wall.
"The seventh to ninth levels train the body, skin, flesh, muscles, bones, qi and blood. To put it bluntly, they are constantly squeezing the potential of one's body."
"When you reach the peak of seventh level, you have trained your body to the limit. If you go up further, you can't just train your body."
"Starting from the sixth level, a martial artist can refine the true energy within his body."
"When the true energy is used properly, it can be attached to the weapon, and it can hurt monsters even after several steps."
"It can also form a layer of protection around the body, which is different from using the body to carry it."
Qin Lie listened very carefully. He originally thought that everyone was practicing physical training, but he didn't expect that people above the seventh level would start practicing qi.
"What does that first grade look like?"
Li Tiezhu glanced at him.
"I told you just now that you have a big appetite. I saw you clearly. You have a terrible appetite!"
"You are only at the peak of the seventh rank, and you are starting to miss the first rank again."
"I just want to know if our general is a first-class master?"
Li Tiezhu followed his gaze and looked at the tower, where Pei Jinghan was still standing.
In the past two days, as long as there is a big monster that cannot be dealt with by his soldiers, he will definitely take action.
Li Tiezhu's voice was lowered a bit, and it was a tone that sounded a little awe even to a peak sixth-grade master like him.
"The ninth level to the seventh level is called the third level of body refining, the sixth level to the fourth level is called the third level of qi refining, and the third level to the first level is called the third level of master."
"A person like me who has reached the peak of the sixth level is already somewhat capable, but in front of General Pei, I am not even qualified to lift shoes."
"As for the first grade..."
"That's not what people like us should think about. If a person like General Pei stands on the tower, he can ensure that the entire Duanfeng Camp army remains focused. This is the first grade!"
Qin Lie looked at Pei Jinghan's back and didn't ask any more questions.
It is indeed a bit overwhelming to ask Li Tiezhu, the pinnacle of the sixth grade, to describe the power of the first grade to him.
It would be nice if I had the chance to see Pei Jinghan and ask him in person, but the current Qin Lie is obviously not qualified.
In the following time, Qin Lie's realm never improved again.
It's not that he doesn't want to, it's that basic physical training has reached its limit, and qigong training is necessary to move forward.
Without skills, just having attribute points is useless.
It is possible to redeem it in the family property value system, but my own family property value is not enough.
It seems that after returning this time, Liu Yunniang and the others must be picked up.
However, fortunately, the three dimensions have not been filled up yet, and the free attribute points are still useful.
On the third day, he stretched his physique to the limit that the seventh-grade peak could bear.
That day, the demon clan charged at the city wall five times, and Qin Lie continued to kill them from morning until dusk.
After improving his physique, he felt that his physical strength became more durable.
Before, I could only play for an hour continuously, and my hands would start to shake.
Now as long as he is given a little breathing space, he can stand up again and fight again.
On the fourth day, he stretched his agility to the limit.
When the monster pounced on him, he could clearly see its movements.
As soon as the low-level monster climbed up the city wall, his sword had already slashed through it.
Those monsters in the middle and late stages of the Little Demon Realm can quickly and temporarily change their bodies if they want to pounce on him.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 48 Meeting Pei Jinghan Volume 1 Chapter 47 Peak of Seventh Grade
